registryCustodian: Official Gdynia WebEWID map documentation identifies the city's public map viewer; the verified parcel-vector response was obtained from GUGiK's official aggregate EGiB WFS, which aggregates county cadastral services.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Polish discovery queries found official Gdynia WebEWID documentation and official GUGiK EGiB WFS documentation/service URLs. Local documentation confirms parcel search; national WFS supplied the qualified sample.
requestOutcomes: Gdynia historical map URL returned 404; current official documentation returned 200. GUGiK GetCapabilities, DescribeFeatureType, and bounded GetFeature returned 200. The bounded response returned three parcel polygons and native IDs. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, TLS exception, or unsafe field request was used.

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: Native ID values include cadastral unit/precinct/parcel components; no synthetic row number was used.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [54.5322041862711, 18.5076341710355] was preserved and not shifted.
Three returned polygons are bounded sample evidence, not citywide coverage proof.
National aggregate service evidence does not by itself qualify a runtime adapter.
No unsafe personal, ownership, title, address, contact, tax/account, or certificate fields were requested or retained.

qualification.reason: Safe native IDs and unchanged geometry were verified, but independent serial review and citywide coverage qualification remain required.

uncertainty: The sample is strong first-party evidence for public parcel geometry in Gdynia, while the local live viewer endpoint and citywide completeness remain unverified.
